notes.title: 🌍 Translation Update: Coming Soon in Multiple Languages! 🌍
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/85b16482bb2781f8489dd4d10cb46e4e2a5ef5b5.png

Hello, horny gamers! We have some exciting news to share with you all. We're thrilled to announce that we are currently working on translating Love Season into multiple languages, starting with Portuguese (Brazil). But that's not all! We also have plans to add French, Italian, Russian, and Spanish translations.

As a small team with limited resources, we'll be initially relying on machine translation for these additional languages. However, we will be slowly working on proofreading and improving these translations over time.

We would love to invite you to join us in this endeavor. If you're fluent in any of the languages we mentioned (French, Italian, Russian, or Spanish) and would like to help us refine the translations, we encourage you to join our Discord - there you'll find all the information you need to help us (and it's a pretty easy and simple process!). Together, we can make our game accessible to a broader audience and ensure that the translations are top-notch.

We deeply appreciate your support and understanding as we work diligently to enhance the gaming experience for everyone. Stay tuned for future updates and announcements regarding the translations and other exciting updates coming to the game!

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/CQUvJG5

Thank you for being a part of our amazing community! ❤

notes.title: 04/28/2023 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/241083450dd4904bb274ddcbc81957e6b003d9cd.gif

We're working on adding more animations to Love Season! 11 animations were added so far:
Amanda&Sophie (Chapter 9): 4 animations
Elise (Chapter 9): 1 animation
Mia (Chapter 9): 5 animations
Angela (Chapter 8): 1 animation

The Extra section of the gallery was updated with 50 new pictures, some replacing pictures that eventually got into the game.

You'll see a new option in the main menu: Jump to. Now you can start the game from any chapter in case you lost your saves or want to replay a chapter you don't have a save for.

notes.title: About the "Big" Update
notes.notes:
Recently we released an update that made you basically download the game again. It wasn't added any new content though. We fixed a small bug when playing the Extra Scene "Extra 1 - Heather" in the Replay Room and, most importantly, changed the file structure of the game - something we had to do to make it easier to release updates and make it possible to release extra content (DLCs). The game size didn't change; we removed the old files and added new ones.

We're sorry for the inconvenience! 

What's coming next:

https://i.imgur.com/S6f4g8i.png
Love Season - Winter is a DLC that adds a whole new chapter to the game (although it's not classified as a new chapter in the game as it happens during Chapter 6).

https://i.imgur.com/UhV4zWQ.png
More information about it soon!
